paragraphs: In Beitzah 31b: “Rav Nachumi bar Ada said in Shmuel's name.” Eruvin 34b reads Rav Nachman bar Ada.
Mentioned in Eruvin 102a, saying, “If one made a handle for it, it is permitted.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice places the abbreviated Nachumi occurrence beside an explicit Nachman variant. “Handle” translates the functional idiom בית יד.

The checked Beitzah passage has Rav Nachumi bar Ada reporting Shmuel, while the consulted Eruvin parallel has Rav Nachman bar Ada. A separate Eruvin passage names Nachumi bar Zekharyah asking Abaye. These occurrence-specific forms remain distinct; no identity or legal conclusion is inferred from their comparison.
